featured_techniques.technique: Authenticity-focused questioning to assess leadership realism

sections.description: Jeanne Bliss prompts viewers with questions about how real they are as leaders: connecting with people, creating an environment for employees to bring their best selves, and ensuring decisions align with personal values.
sections.title: Authenticity in Leadership: Core Questions

summary: This succinct clip presents a leadership-focused reflection on authenticity. Jeanne Bliss asks whether leaders connect with people in a human way and whether they foster an environment that lets employees bring their best selves to work. The introspective questions frame authenticity as foundational to a workplace culture that can feel like a business home, where decisions align with personal values and life outside the office.
title: How Real Are You? Authentic Leadership in a Human-Centric Workplace
topics: bringing your best self to work
congruence between personal and work decisions
